import pandas as pd
from collections import Counter

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/en_train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/en_test_2.csv")

# Create holdout split from training data - validation rows never used for mapping construction
split_idx = int(len(train) * 0.9)
train_final = train.iloc[:split_idx].reset_index(drop=True)
val_holdout = train.iloc[split_idx:].reset_index(drop=True)

# Build normalization mapping from training data only (NOT using validation)
normalization_map = {}
for text, after in zip(train_final["before"], train_final["after"]):
    if text not in normalization_map:
        normalization_map[text] = []
    normalization_map[text].append(after)

# Get most common normalization for each text
most_common = {
    text: Counter(normalizations).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for text, normalizations in normalization_map.items()
}

# Validation on hold-out data using mapping built ONLY from train portion
val_preds = [
    most_common.get(row["before"], row["before"]) for _, row in val_holdout.iterrows()
]
val_acc = (
    sum(p == t for p, t in zip(val_preds, val_holdout["after"]))
    / len(val_holdout)
    * 100
)
print(f"Validation accuracy (holdout from training data only): {val_acc:.2f}%")

# Generate test predictions using the same mapping built from training data
test_preds = [
    most_common.get(row["before"], row["before"]) for _, row in test.iterrows()
]

# Create submission in required format
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test["sentence_id"].astype(str) + "_" + test["token_id"].astype(str),
        "after": test_preds,
    }
)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows")
